name: Hanzomon
tagline: Otemachi in 8 minutes and Shibuya in 11 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥160,000 to ¥170,000.
summary: The station is in Chiyoda City, served by Tokyo Metro Hanzomon Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 8 minutes to Otemachi, 17 minutes to Shinjuku, 11 minutes to Shibuya and 25 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥160,000 to ¥170,000. The station stands 29.4 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 20.8 m. The land around the station rises and falls sharply.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 29.4 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 10 m to 30.8 m, a difference of 20.8 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, neither the station nor any of the nine points within 400 m of it falls inside the projected inundation area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 11 clinics and 15 pharmacies. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at 茂恵会半蔵門病院, about 106 m away and 友仁会赤坂見附前田病院, about 1073 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyo Metro Hanzomon Line. Only one line runs here, so when it stops you will be walking to a station on another line. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 32.

rentRange.note: One room ¥160,000 to ¥170,000, 1K ¥150,000 to ¥160,000, 1LDK ¥310,000 to ¥320,000 and 2LDK ¥500,000 to ¥510,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥160,000 to ¥170,000. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.note: 408 m away in a straight line. It takes 6 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Hanzomon. One-room rents run about ¥8,000 higher.
816 m away in a straight line. It takes 4 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Hanzomon. One-room rents run about ¥31,000 lower.

People who want to finish their shopping on foot
People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
notFor: People who would rather not walk up and down slopes
People who want another route when service is suspended
People who want to hold the rent down
